findings.title: Commit subjects violate commitlint scope and ticket convention
findings.problem: Three commits use scope 'opencode', which is not in commitlint.config.cjs scope-enum (cli, agents, providers, assistants, config, proxy, workflows, ci, analytics, utils, deps, tests, skills, kimi). All 4 subjects also carry [EPMCDME-15955] in the subject, which git-workflow.md Anti-Patterns says belongs in the body footer.
findings.impact: commitlint rejects these subjects at commit-msg and squash history would carry non-conforming messages; blocks the workflow.
findings.recommendation: Reword the commits to an allowed scope such as agents (e.g. fix(agents): recognise -s <id> in resume detection), remove the bracketed key from subjects and add a 'Refs: EPMCDME-15955' footer.

fix.change: Reworded 4 commit subjects to scope agents, dropped ticket from subject, added Refs: EPMCDME-15955 footer

findings.title: Combined -sses_x form not detected for resume
findings.problem: extractNativeResumeId uses flagValue(args, ['--session','-s']), which does not match the attached short form `-sses_x`; resume handling is skipped though opencode resumes natively.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger (uncommon attached short-form); workaround is `-s ses_x` or `--session`. Reachability not further confirmed.
